name: Adept of the Flame (Achievement)
body:
You’ve harnessed the power of your magic and rained down devastation upon your enemies.

Prerequisite: Bloodline class feature. Deal a cumulative total of 1000 points of fire damage to enemies in combat.

Benefit: Add +1 to the DC for all saving throws against spells with the fire descriptor. This bonus stacks with the bonus from Spell Focus and Greater Spell Focus.
